# Auto-generated schematic symbols
import sys
import os

# Get project path and import kicad schematic interface
PROJECT_PATH = os.environ['PROJECT_PATH']
sys.path.append(PROJECT_PATH)
from modules.kicad_sch_interface import *

# Define center of the schematic (A4 sheet 210x297 mm)
center_x_1, center_y_1 = 105.0, 148.5

# Place USB_B connector (reference J1) at the center
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="Connector",
    symbol_name="USB_B",
    pos_x=center_x_1,
    pos_y=center_y_1,
    reference="J1",
    value="USB_B",
    rotation=0,
    mirror=None
)

# Place VBUS power symbol near the connector (to the left‑up)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="VBUS",
    pos_x=center_x_1 - 20,
    pos_y=center_y_1 + 20,
    reference="#PWR_VBUS",
    value="VBUS",
    rotation=0,
    mirror=None
)

# Place GND power symbol near the connector (to the right‑down)
add_schematic_symbol(
    symbol_lib="power",
    symbol_name="GND",
    pos_x=center_x_1 + 20,
    pos_y=center_y_1 - 20,
    reference="#PWR_GND",
    value="GND",
    rotation=0,
    mirror=None
)

# Add label D+ next to the D+ pin of the USB_B connector
x_J1_Dp, y_J1_Dp = get_pin_location(symbol_ref="J1", pin_name="D+")
add_label(
    label_pos=[x_J1_Dp + 5, y_J1_Dp],
    label_text="D+",
    label_ref="D+_0",
    label_type="bidirectional",
    text_orient="right"
)
# Connect label D+ to the connector pin
connect_pins("D+_0", "1", "J1", "D+")

# Add label D- next to the D- pin of the USB_B connector
x_J1_Dm, y_J1_Dm = get_pin_location(symbol_ref="J1", pin_name="D-")
add_label(
    label_pos=[x_J1_Dm + 5, y_J1_Dm],
    label_text="D-",
    label_ref="D-_0",
    label_type="bidirectional",
    text_orient="right"
)
# Connect label D- to the connector pin
connect_pins("D-_0", "1", "J1", "D-")

# Connect VBUS pin of the connector to the VBUS power symbol
connect_pins("#PWR_VBUS", "VBUS", "J1", "VBUS")

# Connect GND pin of the connector to the GND power symbol
connect_pins("#PWR_GND", "GND", "J1", "GND")

# Write out all wires
write_out_all_wires()
